title: Bioactivity and Therapeutic Potential of Kaempferol and Quercetin: New Insights for Plant and Human Health
abstract: As it is reported, kaempferol and quercetin has cardioprotective and antihypertensive benefits in human [[30](https://www.mdpi.com/2223-7747/11/19/2623#B30-plants-11-02623)]. The lowest level of quercetin was found in Brassica alboglabra, Raphanus sativa, Sesbania grandifolia and Phaeomeria speciose (14, 17, 18 and 21 mg/kg respectively), while the lowest level of kaempferol were found in Hydrocotyl asiatica (20 mg/kg) and Sesbania grandifolia (21 mg/kg) [[31](https://www.mdpi.com/2223-7747/11/19/2623#B31-plants-11-02623)]. We recently reported that pathogenic stress induces F3H gene which enhance the accumulation of kaempferol and quercetin [[51](https://www.mdpi.com/2223-7747/11/19/2623#B51-plants-11-02623)].
